condition: contains_text('non-compete', 'non compete', 'restraint of trade', 'shall not engage in any business', 'shall not carry on any business')
description: The contract restrains a party from carrying on a business or trade. Under s.27 such a restraint is void unless it falls within the sale-of-goodwill exception.
remedy_suggested: Remove the restraint, or narrow it to non-solicitation and non-use of Confidential Information, which s.27 does not void.
